# June 2026

> Provider API keys from .env, global installs for Codex and Claude, updated Claude Opus model, credits visibility, and independent memory file controls

## More Control Over Providers, Credits, and Memory

June 2026 brings `.env`-based provider API keys, global installation support for Codex and Claude, an updated Claude Opus model, per-request credit usage visibility, and independent toggles for personal and project memory files.

## New Features

### Provider API Keys from `.env`

<Card title="Automatic API Key Loading" icon="key" color="#F24A07">
  Configure provider API keys directly in your project's environment file.
</Card>

Provider API keys can now be loaded from an environment file — the plugin picks them up automatically, no manual configuration required.

***

### Global Installation for Codex and Claude

**Global installation support** for Codex and Claude is now available, making it easier to share runtimes across projects without re-downloading on every run.

***

### Updated Claude Opus Model

The plugin has been updated to use the **latest Claude Opus model**.

***

### Credits Usage Visibility

<Card title="See What You're Spending" icon="chart-line" color="#9333EA">
  Track credits used per request alongside your remaining monthly balance.
</Card>

You can now **see the credits used by each request**, along with your remaining monthly credits — giving you clearer visibility into usage as you work.

***

### Independent Memory File Controls

**Enable or disable your personal and project memory files independently**, giving you finer-grained control over what context the agent retains between sessions.

***

## Bug Fixes

* Various bug fixes and stability improvements
